key.expected_answer: DoubleCross needs opponent troop in Conflict but no own supply troop required;GunThopter Agent unaffected opponent with no garrisoned troop;GuildEnvoy must discard hand card on Agent turn.

question.question: What restrictions apply to Double Cross and Gun Thopter even if other parts of the card could operate?

key.expected_answer: Double Cross requires at least one opponent troop in the Conflict, but you need not have a troop in your own supply. An opponent with no garrisoned troops is unaffected by Gun Thopter’s Agent box.
source_references: Official FAQ p2 Double Cross and Gun Thopter; Guild Envoy excluded as Uprising card.
